jobs.description:
Do you have a technical mindset?Are you passionate about machines and technology? Do you live near Waregem? 
Then this opportunity is for you!

For a leading company specialized in certified labels, we are looking for a Technical Operator in 2 Shifts or a Fixed Morning Shift!

What are your tasks?

• Operating complex machines on the production line
• Setting temperatures
• Setting parameters
• Filling machines with very precise quantities of materials
• Adhering to strict safety regulations

Who are you?

• You have a strong technical background, gained through education or work experience. 
• You speak Nederlands or English.
• You have your own transport.
• Experience in this sector is a plus!

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

You will contribute to the development and optimization of applications that support operations with real-time data & feedback. You will implement new features and improve existing modules within a modern frontend stack where performance, reliability, and usability are key.
You will also support the team with your technical expertise in Angular, helping maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability, and reusability. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, UX specialists, and product stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver robust and scalable enterprise applications.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with Angular & front-end development in general
• Experience in Java-environments
•  10 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.
You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.
A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.
You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a CNC Turner/Programmer? This role places you at the heart of precision manufacturing, where you'll operate and program CNC turning machines using advanced Heidenhain and Siemens control systems. Your expertise will ensure the production of high-quality, custom-made spare parts for various industrial applications.

A typical day involves collaborating with a team of five skilled professionals, programming and operating CNC machines, and ensuring finished products meet rigorous quality standards. You'll also engage in measuring and inspecting workpieces and occasionally assist in hydraulic cylinder repairs. A clean, organized workspace is a must to maintain safety and efficiency.

If you're passionate about precision and innovation, apply today to join a team that values expertise and teamwork!

• Proven experience as a CNC Turner/Programmer

• Proficiency in Heidenhain and Siemens control systems

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

• Experience in custom machining and measuring techniques

• Good level of English

• Willingness to work in a day shift, starting at 07:00 or 08:00

Onze klant, een biotech bedrijf, gevestigd in Zwijnaarde, is een wereldwijd biotechnologiebedrijf dat de innovatieve CAR-T celtheraptie naar Gent brengt. Het bedrijf maakt hiermee dagdagelijks het verschil in het leven van vele patiënten die lijden aan kanker en andere levensbedreigende ziektes.
Ze zijn momenteel in een fase van sterke groei en zoeken gemotiveerde en toegewijde teamleden. 

Jobomschrijving

We’re looking for skilled individuals to join our mission of transforming medicine. This is more than just a job,it’s an opportunity to advance your career in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment. Whether you have a secondary education with hands-on experience or are a recent graduate with a bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related fields and especially if you’ve worked in cleanrooms, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or chemical processing,we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for dedicated process operators to join our team at a leading biotechnology company. What can you expect in this exciting role?

Your journey begins with extensive training, where we immerse you in the world of aseptic (germ-free) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) operations, including the crucial procedures you need to master.

Afterward, you will join our dynamic and driven Operations team, which works together every day to fulfill our mission. Alongside your fellow operators and team leaders, you will perform aseptic and manual production processes according to strict, proven procedures.

Daily aseptic and manual production processes

Working in a cleanroom lab environment

Executing production steps in controlled environments (grade A/B/C/D) such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products.

Managing equipment: inspections and maintenance

Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials

Supporting transitions between production zones

Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

A strong sense of responsibility and passion to make a difference in the lives of patients.

Clear verbal and written communication skills with an attention to detail and the ability to follow procedures.

You thrive in fast-paced environments and are eager to learn and grow in advanced biomanufacturing.

You like structure and order, are very accurate and are willing to work in an aseptic environment with appropriate sterile clothing.

You have a relevant 'graduaat' or a bachelor’s degree. Alternatively, if you hold a secondary education diploma and have initial experience in a lab or cleanroom or hospital environment, pharmaceutical manufacturing, chemical processing, or similar regulated industries you are also eligible.

You are willing to work in a shift regime 4 days of working 4 days.

You speak very good English.

You’re excited to work with cutting-edge equipment and technologies

Our client is a leading international corporate real estate company. You will join a company offering a stable environment, strong team spirit and opportunities to develop your skills. They are located in the centre of Brussels close to the metro, bus and train stations in a new modern building.

Jobomschrijving

As Meetings & Event Coordinator, you will ensure successful planning and execution of meetings and events.

• Coordinate and support delivery of meetings, conferences and events from planning to execution.
• Prepare and set up meeting rooms and event spaces.
• Coordinate guest services, catering, transportation and other event-related logistics.
• Manage meetings and events calendar and contribute to post-event reporting and follow-up.
• Support in general office management.

• First experience in events, hospitality, office management or administration is a plus (internships included).
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Service-oriented mindset and professional communication skills.
• Proactive, hands-on and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word and Excel).

Nike ELC is an innovative employer with distribution centres in Laakdal and Tessenderlo-Ham and is responsible for all European Nike orders.

Jobomschrijving

As a warehouse worker for Nike ELC, you are trained to execute several tasks, such as loading and sorting of incoming and outgoing Nike products, orderpicking, labelling and packaging orders.

We are looking for all-round employees, who are flexible to rotate over several area’s and tasks.

Nike has excellent on-the-job training so you don’t need to have any relevant work experience; enthusiasm and willingness to learn are far more important!

 

	
• Your knowledge of English is very good (you can find vacancies for Dutch speaking candidates on www.startpeople.be/nike)	
• You want a full-time job and are eager to outperform during peak periods (working extended during weekends)	
• You want to work in an early and late shift pattern (06h00-14h00 Mon-Fri, 14h00-22h00 the week after)	
• You have your own means of transportation (the Nike campus is not accessible by bus or train)	
• You are looking forward to having a dynamic job that requires you to walk a lot and lift heavy orders (+/- 20 kg on a regular basis)

Do you have a solid experience as a CE Truck Driver and enjoy delivering items from point A to point B? Then this might be exactly the opportunity you're looking for! We're looking for a reliable professional who takes pride in delivering vehicles in perfect condition.

In this role, you will take charge of transporting various vehicles, including vans and trucks, to different destinations. 

 
• Safely loading, securing, and unloading vehicles. 
Checking the load, transport documentation, and ensuring everything is delivered correctly. 

 
• Keeping the truck, trailer, and all equipment well-maintained and in top condition. 
 

 
• Providing a brief handover explanation when delivering the vehicle to the customer. 
 
• Representing the company professionally while on the road. 

 
• A valid CE driving license + Code 95. 
 
• Experience with vehicle loading, securing, and transport. 
 
•  
A precise, safety-focused way of working. 

 
•  
Proficiency in Dutch or English (French is a plus) 

 
•  
A friendly, professional communication style and appearance. 

 
•  
Flexibility: your schedule won't always be a standard 9-to-5; starting earlier or finishing later is part of the job.

Our client is a leading international group active in industrial solutions. Operating in a dynamic Benelux environment, they combine global standards with local agility. They are looking for an EHS Specialist to strengthen safety culture, support operations and projects, and drive continuous improvement across multiple entities.

Jobomschrijving

• Champion a strong safety and environmental culture
• Maintain and improve EHS systems (ISO 45001, ISO 14001, VCA)
• Support projects with safety methodologies (HAZOP, RAMS, PSSR)
• Act as EHS point of contact for operational field teams
• Conduct risk assessments, audits, and site safety reviews
• Investigate incidents and define preventive measures
• Deliver EHS training and awareness programs
• Ensure compliance with BE/NL regulations and reporting

• 2+ years in EHS within an industrial or service environment
• Strong knowledge of safety regulations (Belgium required, NL is a plus)
• Experience with EHS management systems (ISO 45001 / VCA)
• Familiar with project safety tools (HAZOP, RAMS…) is a plus
• Fluent in Dutch and English; French is a strong asset
• Autonomous, pragmatic, and hands-on mindset
• Strong communicator with influencing skills

jobs.occupation: Freelance Accountant and Internal Control Consultant
jobs.description:
Our client is a construction company.

Jobomschrijving

Accounting

• Manage day-to-day accounting activities for one or several entities.
• Prepare and review monthly, quarterly and annual closings.
• Perform balance sheet reconciliations and ensure the accuracy of accounting records.
• Monitor accounts payable, accounts receivable and general ledger postings.
• Prepare VAT declarations and support other tax compliance obligations.
• Assist in the preparation of statutory accounts and audit files.
• Coordinate with external auditors, accountants and tax advisors.
• Ensure compliance with Belgian accounting standards and company policies.

Internal Control

• Assess and document existing financial and operational processes.
• Identify control weaknesses and propose pragmatic improvement actions.
• Ensure proper segregation of duties and compliance with internal procedures.
• Review approval workflows, authorizations and financial governance processes.
• Support the implementation and monitoring of internal control frameworks.
• Perform periodic control testing and follow-up on remediation actions.
• Participate in risk assessments and recommend mitigating measures.
• Support finance leadership in strengthening audit readiness and compliance.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or Economics.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in accounting combined with exposure to internal control, audit or compliance activities.
• Experience from construction, real estate or architect companies (must have).
• French and English.

jobs.occupation: Accounting and Reporting Manager in Brussels
jobs.description:
This newly created position combines technical accounting expertise, business partnering and people management, offering the opportunity to build and develop a function with significant visibility across the organization.

You will work closely with a variety of stakeholders while ensuring accurate reporting, financial transparency and high-quality service delivery.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will oversee accounting and reporting activities for centrally managed costs and third-party managed assets while acting as a trusted finance partner to key stakeholders.

• Partner with central functions such as IT, Legal and other support teams on financial performance and cost management.
• Own the accounting, reporting and control of centrally managed expenditures.
• Manage the reporting and relationship with third-party property owners, ensuring accurate information and timely responses to inquiries.
• Review monthly financial results, analyse variances and provide clear financial insights.
• Coordinate month-end closing activities, reconciliations and intercompany recharges.
• Drive process improvements, strengthen controls and support systems-related initiatives.
• Lead, coach and develop a small team, fostering collaboration and high performance.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Solid accounting background with at least 7 years of experience in accounting and financial reporting.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication skills - French and Dutch
• Previous experience managing and developing team members, with a genuine interest in people leadership.
• Strong business partnering mindset and the ability to build effective relationships with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
• Experience working in an international, multi-entity or shared services environment is a plus.
• Strong knowledge of SAP; experience with ERP implementations or system improvements is highly valued.

Step into an exciting role as a Folding Machine Operator - this is your chance to work with a team committed to crafting the future of the printing industry, leveraging cutting-edge technology and a no-nonsense approach.Your day will involve setting up and operating folding machines like the Heidelberg Stahlfolder, ensuring that all materials meet quality standards. You’ll perform regular maintenance and minor repairs, keeping your workspace organized and efficient. Collaboration is key, so you’ll hand over tasks smoothly to your colleagues to maintain seamless production.Ready to make your mark in a future-focused company? Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career with ample opportunities for growth and development.

• Strong technical insight, preferably with a technical degree

• Ability to work independently and with precision

• Hands-on attitude, ready to assist wherever needed

• Flexibility to switch machines or work overtime when necessary

• At least 5 years of experience as a folding operator in a printing company

• Experience with perfect binding is a plus

• Proficient in English

We are looking for a logistic operator for warehouse in Vilvoorde. The company is active in the medical field. You will join the kitting team and provide support to clinical supplies operations and administrative activities in all areas of clinical supplies lifecycle of low to moderate complexity studies.

Your tasks:

 

 
• You support logistics and administrative tasks related to clinical supplies and medical devices. 
 
• You ensure smooth processes for ordering, storage, labelling, shipping, and returns. 
 
• You track inventory levels and expiration dates, and prepare monthly reports. 
 
• You ensure all activities follow guidelines and internal procedures. 
 
• You maintain accurate data in electronic systems for the assigned studies. 
 
• You perform routine tasks and prepare the kits for the labs. 
 
• You handle ad-hoc supply purchases when needed. 

Your profile:

 

 
• You have a good command of English (spoken and written). 
 
• You have at least 2 years of relevant experience in a warehouse environment. 
 
• You are comfortable using computers and electronic equipment. 
 
• You are able to sit for 4–6 hours per day. 
 
• You can lift light objects (up to 7–9 kg). 
 
• You have a solid knowledge of clinical supply processes (e.g. manufacturing, shipping, labeling, auditing). 
 
• You are proficient in Microsoft Office. 
 
• You pay close attention to detail and quality-focused. 
 
• You are available for at least a month. 
 
• You can work from 7h30 - 15h36 OR 14h - 22h.

Responsibilities:

At this position, your tasks will be highly varied. One day you might be performing (preventive) maintenance on industrial compressors, while the next you could be conducting complex repairs on a generator. In short, you'll have plenty of technical challenges and day-to-day variety.

• Conduct maintenance and repairs on rental equipment such as diesel generators and compressors to ensure optimal performance and safety

• Perform scheduled inspections and preventive maintenance routines to guarantee fleet reliability

• Troubleshoot technical issues, including mechanical and electrical problems, on site or in the workshop

• Prepare equipment efficiently after use to ensure readiness for the next customer

• Document maintenance activities and communicate technical findings clearly to team members and clients

• At least 2/3 years as a workshop technician/ engineer
• Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics or a related technical field
• Strong knowledge of diesel engines, compressors, and electrical systems, including reading electrical diagrams 
• Fluency in English, with excellent communication skills for technical discussions and documentation
• Proven problem solving skills, results oriented mindset, and the ability to work independently or in a team
• Flexibility regarding working hours and a proactive attitude toward continuous learning and development

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.
Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

Do you enjoy technical work and want to see the tangible result of what you build? As an electrical installer, you will be responsible for setting up technical control rooms in the workshop and will work with both electrical components and plastic installations.

You will work on a day schedule, in a modern workshop, with a salary between €17 and €19 per hour, depending on your experience.

 
• 
Install pumps, pipes and measuring equipment.

 
• 
Carry out electrical work such as pulling cables, installing cable trays, and connecting devices and electrical panels.

 
• 
Drill holes and install PVC, PP and PE connection pipes and couplings.

 
• 
Work based on technical diagrams and plans.

 
• 
You have knowledge of electricity and can read electrical diagrams.

 
• 
You can work based on technical plans and diagrams.

 
• 
You enjoy working with your hands and seeing the tangible results of your work.

 
• 
You are interested in different types of technical work and practical activities.

 
• 
You pay attention to correct execution and proper finishing.

 
• 
You speak English.

EDR Antwerp Shipyard is the largest shipyard in Belgium, specialised in ship maintenance and repairs, hull treatment and marine construction. Challenging activities require skilful and motivated team members. Over 150 vessels annually are repaired and maintained at our shipyard in Antwerp, and projects are performed on board vessels across the world.
 

As a 
Crane Operator, you play a key role in ensuring safe, efficient and well organised lifting operations within and around our dry dock. You will primarily operate one of our 
five cranes and support a wide range of dockside activities that contribute directly to vessel repair and maintenance projects. You will join a close knit team of experienced crane operators where teamwork and safety are central.
 

RESPONSIBILITIES
 

• Operate one of the 
five cranes on site, including a Wolff tower crane, a Wolff luffing jib crane and three fully restored shipyard cranes with lifting capacities of up to 100 tonnes
 

• Carry out lifting operations safely and efficiently in accordance with site procedures and operational requirements
 

• Support signalling and guidance of lifting movements in areas with limited visibility or restricted access
 

• Assist with dry dock operations (such as the positioning of docking blocks)
 

• Actively support crane operations by maintaining clear lifting zones, monitoring traffic routes and minimising downtime
 

• Coordinate incoming materials and deliveries, ensuring safe and appropriate storage locations are assigned
 

• Serve as a communication link between subcontractors, shipyard teams, vessel crews and fellow crane operators
 

• Provide basic rigging support and assist colleagues in selecting and using suitable lifting equipment
 

• Maintain good order, cleanliness and safety standards around the dry dock area
 

• Identify, report and document damage, deviations and unsafe situations
 

• Support other operational activities on site when crane work is temporarily unavailable

• Good knowledge of English, which is the primary language used for operational communication, radio contact and coordination with subcontractors and vessel crews
 

• Knowledge of Dutch is an advantage for internal coordination and site instructions. Knowledge of Polish and/or Romanian is considered a strong asset
 

• Strong safety awareness and the ability to maintain oversight and prioritise effectively in a dynamic work environment
 

• Confident communicator with a practical and collaborative approach
 

• Hands on attitude and a consistent commitment to agreed procedures and safety standards
 

• Experience with crane operations, forklifts and/or mobile elevated work platforms is highly advantageous
 

• Flexibility to align working hours (daytime hours) with operational requirements, deliveries and lifting schedules
 

• Weekend work may occur, but is not mandatory and will be arranged in consultation with the other colleagues

For our client, we are looking for a motivated INDUSTRIAL CLEANER.
 

 
• Assisting with emptying the tunnels (partially mechanical/partially manual)
 
• Cleaning large tunnels using a high-pressure cleaner
 
• Assisting with filling the tunnels
 
• Thinking along when adding quantities of spawn
 
• Cleaning transport belts at height (no fear of heights!) 

What do we expect from you as an industrial cleaner?
 

 
• You have some initial experience as an industrial cleaner
 
• You are in good physical health and not afraid to work in a dirty environment
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system (5-13 & 13-21)
 
• You actively contribute to the cleaning process
 
• You are a team player but can also work independently
 
• You speak Dutch, French or English

Are you a skilled welder with an eye for detail and a passion for metalworking? Then we have a great opportunity for you!

Jobomschrijving

As a welder, you will be responsible for accurately assembling and welding a variety of metal constructions based on technical drawings and specifications. You play an important role in delivering high-quality end products and actively contribute to maintaining craftsmanship and reliability. You will work closely with your colleagues to ensure projects are completed efficiently and within set deadlines. In addition, you act as a representative of the organization in contacts with clients and partners.

·        Experience in welding, preferably semi-automatic (TIG is a strong plus)·        Accuracy and a strong focus on quality·        Flexibility and the ability to work under pressure·        Team spirit and a positive work attitude·        A professional and presentable appearance·        Proficiency in Dutch or English·        Willingness to learn and further develop your skills
